preconditions.description: The number of integers n must be between 1 and 400,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in numbers)
preconditions.description: Each integer in the input list must be between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the total number of cells x of the beautiful rectangle.
The product of the dimensions p and q must equal the total number of cells x.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(row)) == q for row in rectangle)
postconditions.description: Each row in the rectangle must contain unique values.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(column)) == p for column in zip(*rectangle))
postconditions.description: Each column in the rectangle must contain unique values.
